recovered_memory.title: Independent Creative Web is separated from Mirror Cartographer by a durable identity and data boundary
recovered_memory.summary: The independent creative surface is not a Mirror Cartographer subsystem, explanation surface, continuity interface, research portal, dashboard, or product funnel. Its separation is structural, linguistic, privacy-preserving, and reversible; it may use local session-scoped state for a self-contained work, but it must not ingest private project material or become an identity system.

claims.text: The repository explicitly defines the independent surface as distinct from Mirror Cartographer explanation, research, worker, continuity, and product-funnel surfaces.

The current repository decision requires structural and linguistic separation, additive directories, independent reversibility, no commerce or behavioral profiling, and only visit-scoped memory unless separately justified.

evidence.message: independent: extend identity notes for The Fourth Room

claims.text: Cross-team continuity should preserve this rule as a namespace and privacy boundary rather than merge independent artifacts into the Mirror Cartographer concept, symbol, project, or identity graphs by default.

Knowledge-graph edges from independent works to Mirror Cartographer should default to provenance_reference or boundary_relation, never identity_equivalence or subsystem_of, unless a later explicit decision supersedes this rule.
claims.acceptance_condition: A dedicated queue item and immutable decision artifact explicitly authorize a changed relationship.

claims.text: Treating every creative web artifact in this repository as a Mirror Cartographer production or public explanation surface.
Whether a future independent work may intentionally establish a documented relationship to Mirror Cartographer without losing independent identity.
claims.resolution_route: Require an explicit queue item, privacy review, namespace mapping, and reversible decision artifact.

contradiction_resolution.apparent_conflict: The Fourth Room uses repeated local interaction and session-scoped memory while the independent surface is required not to become an identity or continuity system.
contradiction_resolution.resolution: Session-scoped state that serves one self-contained visit is compatible with the boundary. Durable cross-session identity, private-source ingestion, project-memory reuse, analytics, profiling, or continuity-graph enrollment are not compatible without a new explicit decision.

falsification_route: Locate a later immutable decision artifact that explicitly merges the independent surface into Mirror Cartographer.
Verify that the artifact names the changed namespace, privacy, storage, and rollback rules.
Until then, reject identity-equivalence and subsystem claims as unsupported.
